form_title: FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5-2 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.notes: Cover fields and the whole summary page are TYPED (born-digital fill, then scanned); the name on the Report Verification line is handwritten. REPORT TYPE IS NOT DETERMINABLE: TWO of the five Type-of-Report boxes carry marks - a handwritten check at '30 Days after the Primary Election' (with an additional illegible ink squiggle just above it) AND a solidly filled-in box at '30 Days after the General Election'. Rather than pick one, report_type_printed is left empty and flagged unreadable; the portal's reporting_period label for this filing is 'Commission C - Brad Frost, Post-Primary'. The amendment control on this version of the form is a RADIO button pair, and the 'No' radio is filled - is_amendment 'No' is solid. BOTH Column B (Year-to-Date) cells, lines 1 and 2, were LEFT BLANK by the filer (empty, not zero). The report date, 04/21/2017, is what the form prints on both the cover and the summary page even though this is a 2016-cycle filing.
